name: Narberth Foodbank
short_description: Nearest foodbank at Narberth. Part of The Trussell Trust network. Open Tue 12-2pm for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Pembrokeshire County Council Allotments
short_description: Pembrokeshire Council allotment sites near Cosheston area
description: Small plots available near Carew and Cosheston. From £18/year. Contact for current availability and waiting lists.

name: St Florence Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at St Florence near Cosheston
description: Volunteer-run community garden maintaining raised beds and polytunnel. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
